findings.title: Delete menu item is never shown in the prom-only list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu now computes canDelete from useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities so the list view (which no longer loads ruler rules) can authorize deletion, but the Delete item is still rendered only when `canDelete && rulerRule`. In GrafanaRuleListItem/RuleActionsButtons.V2 rulerRule is undefined, so Delete never appears for Grafana rules in the new list view even for users with delete permission, despite RuleActionsButtons' handleDelete only needing the identifier/groupIdentifier.

findings.title: Pause menu item is never shown in the prom-only list view
findings.body: canPause is computed as ruler-ability OR grafana-prom-ability, but the Pause item is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` and renders MenuItemPauseRule with that rulerRule. With rulerRule removed from the list view this condition is always false, so Pause/Unpause is unavailable there even when the new grafana prom ability grants it.

findings.title: Silence action does nothing for prom-only rules
findings.body: The Silence menu item can now be shown via useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities and clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer, but the drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` where rule is the ruler rule. In the new list view rule is undefined, so SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer (which requires a rulerRule) never opens and silencing from the list silently fails.

findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem in filtered list is missing its React key
findings.body: The 'grafana' case returns <GrafanaRuleListItem> without key={key}, unlike the datasource and unknown cases and unlike the previous GrafanaRuleLoader usage. In an incrementally appended/paginated list React cannot reliably reconcile items, causing warnings and potentially stale/duplicated row state (e.g. open menus/drawers) being reused for a different rule when results change.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: The refactored useAllRulerRuleAbilities (now also backing the deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities for CombinedRule) hardcodes `const isFederated = false` with a TODO, whereas previously useAllAlertRuleAbilities used isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) and marked federated rules immutable. Federated (Mimir cross-tenant) rules will now report Update/Delete/Pause/Duplicate as supported (subject to permissions), offering edits that should be blocked for federated groups.
